data.text: For details about the transition of participants from Study Period 1 to Study Period 2, see the schema (Section 1.2) and the relevant notes in the SoA for Study Period 2 (Section 1.3.2).

data.text: V7 will be conducted on same day as V6
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2)

data.text: For details about the transition of participants from Study Period 1 to Study Period 2, see the schema (Section 1.2). Participants who received LY/mirikizumab co-administration or mirikizumab in Study Period 1 and who are considered responders at Week 12 of Study Period 1 will receive mirikizumab SC starting at Week 0 of Study Period 2. For definition of responders, see Sections 4.1 and 8.1 of the IIBD master protocol. For responders to mirikizumab or LY/mirikizumab co-administration treatment, Visit 6 and Visit 7 will occur on the same day and the Visit 6 procedures are not repeated at Visit 7 (excluding 'Register visit with IWRS'). Visit 8 and Visit 10 of the IIBD master protocol SoA do not apply to this ISA.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2)

data.description: ISA 1 (J6Z-MC-CD01) for LY4395089 in Crohn's Disease. Initial protocol for a Phase 2, Multicenter, Randomized, Open-Label, Active-Controlled Study to Investigate LY4395089/Mirikizumab Co-administration Compared with Mirikizumab in Adults with Moderately to Severely Active Crohn's Disease. Electronically signed and approved by Lilly on 18 Dec 2025 GMT. Document ID: VV-CLIN-211806. Master Protocol Number: J6Z-MC-IIBD. IND: 178821. EU trial number: 2025-524112-11-00.
